data.exact_reserve_text: In 2019, there has been favourable development in the claims estimates that are covered by the contract. The benefit of this reduction (GBP 64.8m) in the best estimate reserves was offset by a reduction in the reinsurance recoverable under the ADC contract (GBP 34.7m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse Development Cover (ADC) purchase and effect
prior_year_events.impact_description: ADC provided whole account protection for 2018 and prior years; in 2019 there was a reduction in best estimate reserves of GBP 64.8m (favourable) which was offset by a reduction in the reinsurance recoverable of GBP 34.7m.

named_events.loss_description: Material accident year large loss noted as a driver of deterioration in Marine and Aviation

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2001 recorded a small net favourable prior-year development in 2019 (approx. GBP 6.6m release gross), driven by general favourable claims development and specific reserve reductions covered by an adverse development cover purchased in December 2018 (a GBP 64.8m reduction in best estimate reserves was partly offset by a GBP 34.7m reduction in the related reinsurance recoverable). Offsetting factors included deterioration in certain prior accident years (notably 2017) and current-year large aviation losses (eg. Ethiopian Airlines/Boeing), resulting in a mixed overall direction.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development in the claims estimates that are covered by the contract.
The benefit of this reduction (GBP 64.8m) in the best estimate reserves was offset by a reduction in the reinsurance recoverable under the ADC contract (GBP 34.7m).

materially impacted by current accident year large losses (notably Ethiopian Airlines/Boeing) and attritional deterioration within the prior accident year (within War, Cargo, Liability and Hull classes).
reduced catastrophe activity in 2019, and prior year reserve releases.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 11b) because the report does not present a single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' aggregate. The triangle shows mixed movements across years (large adverse movement on 2017 offset by releases on multiple older years) yielding a small net gross release (~GBP 6.6m). ADC reinsurance movements (gross reserve reduction of GBP 64.8m and reduction in reinsurance recoverable GBP 34.7m) materially affect net outcomes; narrative net figures in the report are often after reinsurance. Figures presented are in GBP  millions and rounded to one decimal; some LOB-level prior-year amounts are not explicitly quantified in the report and are therefore null.
